_help: Per-repo knobs for the shared AI review panel. This repo is not a service - its content is text an LLM agent reads (skills, commands, plugin manifests) plus per-harness assets. No CI, no compiled language, no PRC. Consumer configs shallow-merge onto the defaults in rd-ai-review-panel/ai-review-config-defaults.json; keys starting with `_` are documentation and are ignored by the validator.

Panel._help: Narrow panel. Only critics that have something to say on text-and-manifest changes are listed; the ones that require code/runtime/rollout/PRC are omitted entirely (not Disabled - they simply do not appear in Conditional).

docs-reviewer._help: MD-to-code drift + skill recipe correctness. Primary value for this repo.

consistency-reviewer._help: Tool descriptions, schemas, injected instruction text as contract, not copy. This repo IS text a model reads.

error-handling-reviewer._help: Swallowed errors in skill helpers, if any exist in this repo's scripts.

simplification-reviewer._help: Helper complexity + response-payload cost when a helper adds a field to something a model reads.

Panel._disabled_help: Explicitly disabled so a future addition to the panel repo's defaults does not silently opt this repo in. security: no secrets/injection/authz surface here. test: no tests in the repo. robustness: no deploy artifact, no ring, no live contract. architecture: file-shape module boundaries are trivial here. compliance: no PRC or threat-model artifacts.

Packs._help: Two widening packs match this repo's shape: content read by an LLM (agent-facing) with a limited context window (context-cost).

Gate._help: No sibling CI on this repo; empty list short-circuits the poll and the review runs immediately.

Prewarm._help: Nothing to pre-compile in a plugin repo.

Verify._help: No build system. Runtime verify degrades to 'quote the code' via prompts/verify/none.md in the panel repo.

Noise._help: MUST and SHOULD post inline; COULD and lower are collapsed. Fewer rounds than a service repo because the diffs are smaller.
